text: Right now, you're moving at about a thousand kilometres an hour. If you're in Britain, the ground is carrying you east. At the equator, it's faster than a jet airliner. You don't feel it, because the speed never changes. The Sun doesn't rise. You turn towards it. The full film: What If Earth Stopped Spinning?
